newsitem.title: USA: Fuji Securities says Orange Cty suit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Securities says Orange Cty suit without merit.

text.p: Fuji Securities Inc said on Wednesday that Orange County, Calif.,'s $120-million-plus lawsuit against the firm was without merit.
"Fuji did nothing which would give rise to liability under any legal theory whatsoever," Fuji attorney Mark Prager said.

Orange County filed a $120-million-plus lawsuit against Fuji Securities, a unit of Fuji Bank Ltd, for its alleged involvement in the county's financial collapse, county attorneys said earlier on Wednesday.
The suit alleged that Fuji Securities lent the county billions of dollars through complex financial transactions that the county maintains were illegal and improper for the county to enter into.

The suit, filed in U.S. Bankruptcy Court, seeks damages from Fuji Securities for allegedly aiding in breach of fiduciary duty, for violations of the state Constitution, and for violations of the U.S. Bankruptcy code.
Orange County filed for protection under Chapter 9 of the federal Bankruptcy Code on Dec. 6, 1994, after sustaining investment losses of more than $1.6 billion.
The county emerged from bankruptcy in June of this year.
